reason: Health detectors now apply disclosed convention policies: result rows gain pairContext/unitKind (React pairs) and bodyShape (wrappers), HealthReport gains policyExclusions, CoChangePartnerClass gains generated-artifact, and duplicateBodyScan/isGeneratedArtifactPath are exported. Consumers that construct these result types or switch exhaustively on the partner class must add the new members.
